subject.title: fix(speech): strip markdown before TTS and route code-heavy replies by surface

question: Should `stripMarkdown` retain the new public `mode: "speech"` option as the shared plugin-SDK contract for TTS projection, rather than keeping speech cleanup private to speech-core?
rationale: The option is additive, but it changes an imported plugin-SDK surface and determines whether other plugins may rely on speech-specific projection semantics.

options.title: Keep the additive SDK option
options.body: Confirm `mode: "speech"` as the supported shared projection contract and retain focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep speech cleanup private
options.body: Move the cleanup behind a speech-core-local helper if maintainers do not want speech-specific behavior exposed through the text-chunking SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Keep the additive SDK option
recommendation.body: Confirm `mode: "speech"` as the supported shared projection contract and retain focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch introduces the speech-boundary design and is the closest available routing candidate.
